description: Copy a component (with its classes and styles) and insert the copy right after it. Paths after it shift by one — call `read_page` before the next path-based edit (ids don't shift).

targetId.description: The component to copy by its id, as `read_page` shows it after `#` (e.g. "ieyubib", or "call-2-2" in a symbol instance). Stays valid when other components move or are added, unlike a path. Pass this OR the path, not both.

targetPath.description: Path (from the most recent `read_page`) of the component to copy.

name: swebsy_duplicate_section
title: Duplicate section
